description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Zendesk end-users via the native create_or_update endpoint. `POST /api/v2/users/create_or_update.json` atomically creates or updates based on matching email.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Zendesk user (upserted via email).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_upserted / rows_errored). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Zendesk.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

email_column.label: Email Column
email_column.description: Upstream column holding the user's email (Zendesk match key).

name_column.label: Name Column
name_column.description: Upstream column holding the user's display name.

external_id_column.label: External Id Column
external_id_column.description: Upstream column holding an external_id to set on the Zendesk user (optional).

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> Zendesk custom user_field key.

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Safety cap on total rows per run.

name: Zendesk User Upsert
